shp.name: Avanti Feeds Limited
shp.remarksWeb: 1. The information provided in Annexure-B w.r.t Statement showing foreign ownership limits has been given as per the corresponding percentages as available on the NSDL ISSUER portal of the Company for the respective quarters. The percentage pertains to FIIs/FPIs/NRI (Repatriable) and other Foreign Investments (includes indirect Foreign investment, if any).   2. As per the NSE issued Circular Ref. No.: NSE/CML/2022/31 dated June 30, 2022, on the inference of the below FAQ: a. If a shareholder is falling under more than one category in Table III, then the same shall be classified under which category?   Categorization and disclosure of each shareholding category should be carried out in the order prescribed in the format of the shareholding pattern. If a shareholder is falling under more than one category, then the same shall be classified in the category falling first in the order prescribed in the format. Shareholding under any of the categories shall be unique and will not be duplicated under multiple categories. Therefore, the Company has classified the shares held by Director and their relatives (excluding independent directors & Nominee Directors) in the first category as the shareholder is also a Key Managerial Personnel. The guidance of the FAQs is maintained.   b. What needs to be classified under the sub-category of Shareholders who are represented by a nominee Director on the board of the Company or have the right to nominate a representative (i.e. Director) on the board of the Listed Entity?   This sub-category of shareholders includes those who are represented by a nominee Director on the board of the Listed Entity (excluding directors nominated by small shareholders as per section 151 of Companies Act, 2013) or have the right to nominate a representative (i.e. Director) on the board of the Listed Entity (excluding entitlement of small shareholders as per section 151 of Companies Act, 2013). The Company do have nominated directors from Andhra Pradesh Indu

With reference to disclosure of encumbrances other than by way of pledge in relation to the promoter category, please note that the promoters of the Company i.e., Berhyanda Limited and Jusmiral Holdings Limited are parties to certain agreements in relation to certain financing (availed by promoters) under which, amongst other things, promoters have agreed to, inter-alia certain covenants in the nature of encumbrance with respect to 219,930,170 equity shares of the Company held cumulatively by the promoters, being 127,539,592 equity shares held by Berhyanda Limited and  92,390,578 equity shares held  by Jusmiral  Holdings  Limited. Further, each of Jusmiral Midco Limited and Berhyanda Midco Limited (which do not directly hold any equity shares in the Company but hold equity shares in Jusmiral Holdings Limited and Berhyanda Limited (promoters of the Company), respectively) are also parties to certain agreements in relation to certain financing (availed by promoters), under which, amongst other things, there are covenants with respect to, inter-alia, non-disposal of the shares of Jusmiral Holdings Limited and Berhyanda Limited (promoters of the Company) which are held by Jusmiral Midco Limited and Berhyanda Midco Limited, respectively.  2. Ms. Susan Gentile (CFO of AIC Parent, Inc), is the designated significant beneficial owner with respect to the shares held by Berhyanda Limited and Jusmiral Holdings Limited. Please note that the passport number of the SBO has been redacted from the form as it is sensitive personal information. In the said Shareholding Pattern, we have inadvertently mention Non Resident Indians (NRIs) who hold shares on non- repatriable basis (i.e. Non Resident Non Repatriates) in the category of Non-Institutions (Any Others) (Sl.4 (m)). The NRI category of the shareholders, both who hold shares on repatriation and non-repatriation shall be clubbed together and required to be mentioned in the category of Non Resident Indians (NRIs) under the heading Non-Institutions (Sl. 4 (i)). Accordingly, we are submitting herewith the revised Shareholding Pattern.

shp.name: HFCL Limited
shp.remarksWeb: Vinsan Brothers Private Limited (Vinsan) and Shankar Sales Promotion Private Limited (Shankar) were the Promoters of the Company as on September 30, 2025. Vinsan and Shankar have merged with a member of our Promoter Group Entity namely Satellite Finance Private Limited, pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation dated July 8, 2024, which became effective on November 25, 2025. Accordingly, Vinsan and Shankar stand dissolved without winding up and are no longer in existence. The equity shares of the Company held by Vinsan and Shankar stand vested in Satellite Finance Private Limited by operation of law pursuant to the scheme of merger.   Further, pursuant to the aforesaid merger, 3,00,201 shares held by Shankar have been registered in favour of Satellite Finance Private Limited and hence name of Shankar has been removed from the category of Promoter. Additionally, out of 6,71,600 shares held by Vinsan, 4,41,000 shares have also been registered in favour of Satellite Finance Private Limited. As on December 31, 2025, a total of 7,41,201 shares have been registered in favour of Satellite Finance Private Limited, and the balance 2,30,600 shares continue to remain registered in the name of Vinsan and are under process for registration in favour of Satellite Finance Private Limited.

shp.name: HFCL Limited
shp.remarksWeb: The Company allotted 1,00,00,000 and 22,00,000 equity shares on 07.02.2024 and 22.03.2024 respectively pursuant to conversion of warrants. From the above, 1,00,00,000 equity shares were credited to the Companys temporary ISIN i.e. IN8548A01019, on 21.03.2024 by NSDL and were also put under lock-in on the same day. These shares are shown under Body Corporate category of the Promoters, although the same shares were credited  to the Companys permanent ISIN, INE548A01028, on 08.04.2024.  Further, the Company  applied for the listing of the balance 22,00,000 equity shares  on 30.03.2024, for which Listing Approval is awaited. These shares are yet to be credited and will be put under lock-in up to a period of six months from the date of latest trading approval to be received from  the Stock Exchanges. Further, out of 22,00,000 equity shares, 17,00,000 equity shares are  shown under KMP category and the balance 5,00,000 equity shares are shown under Resident Individual category of nominal value in excess of Rs.2 Lacs to take the effect of alloment. Out of the 1,41,00,000 warrants issued on October 15, 2023, 1,22,00,000 warrants have already been converted into an equal number of equity shares by March 31, 2024. Subsequently, the Allotment Committee (Warrants) of the Board of Directors of the Company, in its meeting held on April 11, 2024, also allotted 17,00,000 equity shares pursuant to the conversion of an additional 17,00,000 warrants, leaving a balance of 2,00,000 warrants. Further, the tenure of warrants shall not exceed 18 (eighteen) months from the date of allotment. If the entitlement against the warrants to apply for the equity shares of the Company is not exercised by the Warrant Holders within the aforementioned period of 18 (eighteen) months, the entitlement of the Warrant holder to apply for equity shares of the Company, along with the rights attached thereto, shall expire, and any amount paid by the Warrant Holders for such Warrants shall stand forfeited by the Company.  In view of the above terms of the issue of warrants, 2,00,000 warrants allotted to one of the warrant holders, who has sought early retirement from the Company, and since retired,  did not exercise the conversion option within 18 months from the date of the allotment, i.e. on or before April 14, 2024, stand forfeited, and  amount paid by him for such warrants also stand forfeited and as of the date, no warrant is pending for conversion into equity shares.

shp.name: R R Kabel Limited
shp.remarksWeb: As reported in the earlier quarter, please note that subsequent to the Scheme of Amalgamation effecting merger of Ram Ratna Research and Holdings Private Limited (RRRHPL) and Jag-Bid Finvest Private Limited (JBFPL) into Hemlata Home Solutions Private Limited (HHSPL), HHSPL was converted into a Limited Liability Partnership under the name Hemlata Home Solutions LLP (HHS LLP) with effect from 27 January 2026. However, the name of HHSPL continues to appear as a Promoter Group member in the beneficial position (BENPOS) data as of 30 June 2026, as the process of updating the name to HHS LLP in one of its demat accounts (relating to JBFPL) is still ongoing. HHSPLs name is therefore reflected in the shareholding pattern pursuant to the BENPOS data, pending its name change in the depository system.   During the reporting quarter, Shri Shreegopal Kabra, a Promoter member transferred 4,00,000 equity shares to his grandson, Master Dev Kabra through gift and consequently, pursuant to Regulation 31A(6) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Master Dev Kabra has been classified as a member of the Promoter Group.   As per the information provided to the Company, Mr. Hemant Kabra and Mrs. Sarita Jhawar, members of the Promoter Group, sold 4,00,000 and 2,00,000 equity shares respectively on 30 June 2026. However, due to the T+1 settlement mechanism, the effect of these transactions was not reflected in the BENPOS for the quarter ended 30 June 2026. Accordingly, the shareholding of the said promoter group members have been disclosed in this Shareholding Pattern based on the BENPOS and the shareholding data received from the RTA as of 30 June 2026. However, after factoring the aforementioned sale of shares dated 30 June 202t, the aggregate shareholding of Promoter & Promoter Group will be 6,88,26,196 shares representing 60.85% of the total equity share capital.
